reasons.settings.env.ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL: Run Claude Code's helper calls (page summaries, web search, titles) on Haiku 5.5, named by full model id whatever a gateway's alias table says.
reasons.settings.env.CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WI: Set the auto-compact window the compaction plugin reads.
reasons.settings.env.CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_EXIT: Keep a chat's running shells, agents and monitors from being handed to a Claude Code background worker when the chat exits, so a pfm chat ends where pfm ended it.
reasons.settings.env.CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBAC: Keep the rating survey from popping up in a chat and swallowing the keys pfm types into its pane.
reasons.settings.env.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION: Enable function hooks for pfm's Claude plugins.
reasons.settings.env.CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SP: Lift the agent nesting limit from Claude Code's 3, too shallow for agents that spawn agents.
reasons.settings.env.CLAUDE_CODE_NATIVE_CURSOR: Blink the terminal's own cursor at the prompt, so the cursor style a user sets in the terminal shows instead of the one Claude Code draws.
reasons.settings.env.CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG: Let an unattended chat ride out overloaded and rate-limited requests, waiting out a usage limit, instead of failing the turn after a fixed retry count.
reasons.settings.env.CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK: End a turn after 2 consecutive Stop-hook blocks instead of Claude Code's 8, so a stuck hook cannot loop an unattended chat; no shipped Stop hook blocks twice in a row.
reasons.settings.env.CLAUDE_DISABLE_ADOPT: Drop the exit dialog's offer to move the session into a Claude Code background worker, which would carry a pfm chat on outside its pane.
reasons.settings.env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH: Keep deferred tools behind ToolSearch in every conversation: unset, Claude Code holds tool search off for a resumed conversation that has run tools without it.
reasons.settings.skipAutoPermissionPrompt: Skip the auto mode entry warning, a dialog that blocks an unattended chat.
reasons.settings.skipDangerousModePermissionProm: Skip the bypass-mode consent dialog that blocks a fresh account under claude.permissionMode bypass.
reasons.settings.skipWorkflowUsageWarning: Skip the workflow usage warning, a dialog that blocks an unattended chat.
reasons.settings.tui: Run Claude Code's fullscreen renderer; a seat carrying it also gets CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER (noFlicker), and "tui": "default" or null in claude.settings turns it off.
reasons.userSettings.skipDangerousModePermission: Claude Code counts bypass consent from an account's own settings.json alone on some paths (a background worker, the bypass consent check), never from --settings, so pfm install writes it there too, keeping a value the file already holds.
reasons.registry.leftArrowOpensAgents: Keep ← on an empty prompt from opening the agents view.
